claim: Claim that EULEX was caught spying and is leaving Kosovo. EULEX u kap duke spiunuar. EULEX uhvaćen u špijunaži.
Claim that diaspora ballots were destroyed in Gjakova and the election was rigged. Votat e diasporës u shkatërruan në Gjakovë. Glasovi dijaspore uništeni u Đakovici.
Claim that shops will run out of sugar and sugar will be rationed. Do të mbarojë sheqeri. Nestaće šećera.
Claim that fuel will cost 3 euros per litre next month. Nafta 3 euro. Gorivo 3 evra.
